## For @copilot

**Workflow**: Follow `.team/prompts/PROCESS_MODELING_WORKFLOW.md` for complete process.

**Quick Reference:**
- Read [Document Hygiene Guide](../../docs/DOCUMENT_HYGIENE.md) before creating/updating documentation
